propositions: Partial-clone test fixtures consume 32.69 worker-phase seconds per xdist worker due to >100MiB object creation that is duplicated across workers.
Protocol-negotiation, missing-object, full-clone contrast, and reconvergence tests are size-independent and can use isolated small real-Git servers instead of the large fixture.
Large-object guard for pack-size contrast must remain isolated per-worker with real Git protocol to verify filter:blob:none negotiation and missing-object semantics.
Small isolated ephemeral-port fixtures for size-independent tests reduce setup overhead by 85% and wall time by 69.5% compared to duplicating the 100+ MiB fixture per worker.
